title: Trump heads to rallies in Arizona and Montana after campaign stop-off in Alaska – US politics live
summary_full: Trump has taken to campaigning in conservative-leaning ​parts of competitive states, rather than in more politically diverse areasSign up for the Breaking News US emailDonald Trump has yet to weigh in on the late night ruling from a federal judge that blocks him from barring CNN, MS Now and Politico access to the White House grounds.Previously, the president had blasted Judge Timothy Kelly – a Trump appointee – for issuing a temporary pause on his media ban.
